name: pdf_info
description: Page count, page sizes in points and millimetres, paper name, metadata (title, author, producer, dates) and whether the file is encrypted. Read-only: the file is never modified. Free tier: unlimited.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: Path to the PDF file. ~ is expanded; a relative path is resolved against the working directory

name: pdf_count
description: Page count per file plus the total, for any number of PDFs. Read-only. A file that cannot be read is reported per file; the others still count. Free tier: unlimited.

arguments.name: paths
arguments.desc: Paths to the PDF files

name: pdf_merge
description: Join several PDFs into one, in the order given. Page sizes are kept as they are - a merged file may have mixed page sizes, and the answer says so. Inputs are never modified. Free tier: up to 5 files per merge.

arguments.name: paths
arguments.desc: The PDFs to join, in the order they should appear

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the merged PDF

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if a file is already there. Default false: an existing file is never overwritten

name: pdf_split
description: Write one new PDF per range. Ranges are 1-based and may be open-ended: "1-3,5,7-" gives pages 1-3, page 5, and page 7 to the end. The input is never modified. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: The PDF to split

arguments.name: ranges
arguments.desc: Comma-separated 1-based page ranges, e.g. "1-3,5,7-". An open-ended range runs to the last page

arguments.name: out_path_pattern
arguments.desc: Output path with a placeholder: {n} is the part number (1, 2, 3...), {range} is the range itself (e.g. 1-3), {name} is the input file name without .pdf. Example: ~/out/{name}-{range}.pdf

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace existing outputs. Default false: nothing is overwritten and nothing is written at all if any target exists

name: pdf_pages
description: Pull selected pages out into one new PDF, in the order written: "2,4-6" gives four pages. Asking for a page twice copies it twice. The input is never modified. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: The source PDF

arguments.name: pages
arguments.desc: 1-based pages and ranges to keep, in output order, e.g. "2,4-6" or "5,1,1"

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the extracted PDF

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it exists. Default false

name: pdf_rotate
description: Turn pages by a multiple of 90 degrees, clockwise for a positive number. The rotation is added to whatever the page already had, which is what a sideways scan needs. Writes a new file; the input is never modified. Free tier: files up to 30 pages.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: The source PDF

arguments.name: degrees
arguments.desc: 90, 180, 270 or -90. Positive turns clockwise. Added to the page's existing rotation

arguments.name: pages
arguments.desc: Which pages to turn, e.g. "1" or "2,4-6". Omit for every page

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the rotated PDF

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it exists. Default false

name: pdf_stamp
description: Draw a word such as PAID or DRAFT across the pages, in a colour and position you choose. Writes a new file; the input is never modified. Free tier: the PAID and DRAFT presets in their preset colours.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: The source PDF

arguments.name: text
arguments.desc: What to stamp. PAID and DRAFT are presets with their own colour; any other text is Pro

arguments.name: position
arguments.desc: Where on the page. Default center, which is drawn on the 45-degree diagonal like a real stamp

arguments.name: opacity
arguments.desc: 0 to 1. Default 0.35 in the centre, 0.85 in a corner

arguments.name: color
arguments.desc: Hex code such as #1b7f3b, or a name: red, green, blue, black, gray, orange, purple. Pro

arguments.name: font_size
arguments.desc: Point size. By default the stamp is sized to fit the page width

arguments.name: pages
arguments.desc: Which pages to stamp, e.g. "1" or "2,4-6". Omit for every page

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the stamped PDF

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it exists. Default false

name: pdf_watermark_business
description: Put your own business name and VAT id in the footer of every page, from the shared business profile that mcp-invoice and mcp-docx write. Use it before sending a document out. Pro.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: The source PDF

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the footed PDF

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it exists. Default false

arguments.name: pages
arguments.desc: Which pages, e.g. "1". Omit for every page

name: pdf_reorder
description: Write a new PDF with the pages in the order you give. The order must name every page exactly once, so nothing is dropped by accident - use pdf_pages when you do want a subset. Pro.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: The source PDF

arguments.name: order
arguments.desc: The 1-based page numbers in their new order, e.g. [3,1,2] for a three-page file. Every page must appear exactly once

arguments.name: out_path
arguments.desc: Where to write the reordered PDF

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.desc: Replace out_path if it exists. Default false

name: pdf_text
description: Best-effort text extraction: the page content streams are decompressed and the text-showing operators are read. It works on PDFs written with standard fonts (exports from word processors, invoices, reports). It returns nothing for a scan - there is no OCR - and glyph indices instead of letters when a font ships a custom encoding, and it says which case you are in. Read-only. Free tier: unlimited.

arguments.name: path
arguments.desc: The PDF to read

arguments.name: pages
arguments.desc: Which pages, e.g. "1" or "2,4-6". Omit for every page

name: license_status
description: Show whether this server runs in free or Pro mode and where to upgrade.

name: license_activate
description: Activate a Pro license key (format MCPL1.xxx.yyy). Verified offline and saved locally.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: License key from the checkout confirmation page
